Title: Gehenna Events + Erciyes Fragments question LSJ

Messages.Author: Fizeront
Messages.Body:
If a Gehenna "Do Not Replace" Event (e.g. Dragonbound) is played from
the Erciyes Fragments, ¿is your hand size reduced?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


Yes, you played the card, you undergo the effects.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Fizeront wrote:
> If a Gehenna "Do Not Replace" Event (e.g. Dragonbound) is played from

> the Erciyes Fragments, żis your hand size reduced?

No. You don't replace any card you play from the Fragments, so any replacement
delay/denial clause it may have is redundant.
